subject: Postdoctoral Position for Experienced Agent-based Modeler in Stanford University

messages.author: 56afaa2b66faacb3
messages.subject: Postdoctoral Position for Experienced Agent-based Modeler in Stanford University
parts:
Hi Stan users,

The IRIS Design Lab (macdlab.stanford.edu) in Stanford University is looking to hire an agent-based modeler, with experience using Repast or other agent-based programming preferred. The ideal candidate will also have familiarity with the subject area: modeling the design, distribution, and sales of solar photovoltaic panels and/or cost-of-energy estimation. This will be a two-year commitment as postdoctoral researcher with possible extension for a third year. 


If interested, please send CV, one pdf of a paper, and one code sample to: dp...@stanford.edu.


All applications received by 12/31/2015 will be reviewed. We will appreciate your consideration.


Sincerely,

IRIS Design Lab
